people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac

translations.web: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”
translations.bsb: And Abimelech said, “Look, my land is before you. Settle wherever you please.”
translations.kjv: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee: dwell where it pleaseth
translations.asv: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land is before thee. Dwell where it pleaseth thee.
